name: codebake
description: Foundational docs → Spec → PRD → Codebake tasks → isolated execution. Seven composable skills (agentic-project-docs, spec-writer, prd-writer, task-writer, task-work, next-task, wayfinder) that turn a domain idea into agent-ready foundational docs, a tested PRD, a fully-loaded Codebake project board, and per-task execution in a subagent or the current session; wayfinder charts efforts too big for one session as a map of decision tickets.
